in_marathi.name: Mahadevprasad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahadevprasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahadev: Great God; Prasad: Gift, offering. This name is given to a child who is considered a blessing from the gods, often born into a religious or spiritual family.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mahaa' meaning 'great' or 'big' and 'Devaa' meaning 'god' or 'deity'. The second part of the name, 'Prasad', is a Sanskrit term meaning 'a sacred offering, a blessing, or a gift'.
